description: Demolition and redevelopment to provide two storey detached dwelling with habitable roofspace; parking; landscaping (part retrospective)
decision_conditions: Within 3 months of the date of this decision notice, the applicant shall submit to the Council for approval in writing a Construction Environmental Management Plan (CEMP) focusing on biodiversity and wildlife which will provide full details of measures and timings, including method statements, drawings and specifications required in support of the following criteria which will need to be implemented in order to:a.safeguard features of ecological importance, including areas of semi-natural habitat, protected and priorityspecies known or likely to use the site and its features for foraging, shelter, reproduction, commuting or other purposes, and the features of value to these species;b.avoid impacts on habitats in areas adjoining the development site, and at its boundaries in particular;c.ensure that contractors and those responsible for overseeing the development will implement necessary measures in full.d.A clear supervision / monitoring program to ensure all contractors and those overseeing the developmentfully implement the approved measures. To be overseen by an ecologist to supervise sensitive activities and monitor compliance throughout demolition and construction.The construction works shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved CEMP, in order to safeguard features of ecological importance, including areas of semi-natural habitat, protected and priority species known or likely to use the site and features for foraging, shelter, reproduction, commuting or other purposes, on which they wholly or partly depend.REASON: To protect natural capital and features of nature conservation importance in accordance with statutory requirements, current best practice, policy G13 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041) and the objectives of the Harrow Biodiversity Action Plan.

Within 3 months of the date of this decision notice, details for the attenuation, storage and disposal of surface water to be provided on site shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the works so agreed and the works shall thereafter be retained.REASON: To ensure that the development incorporates sustainable drainage systems and achieves greenfield run-off rates, and to ensure the separation of surface and foul water systems, in accordance with Policy CN3 and CN4 Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).

Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, details of a cycle store system and theirdimensions shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The developmentshall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall be thereafter retained.REASON: To ensure the satisfactory provision of safe cycle storage facilities, to provide facilities for all theusers of the site and in the interests of highway safety and sustainable transport, in accordance with Policy T5of The London Plan (2021) and Policy M1 and M2 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).

The development hereby permitted shall be undertaken in accordance with the Tree Protection Plan OS 2293-21.1 and Arboriculture Impact Assessment OS 2293-21 Doc 1 subject to the pre-arranged tree protection monitoring and site supervision as detailed in the report by the appointed Arboricultural consultant, unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.REASON: To protect the trees of amenity value and to safeguard the appearance of the locality, inaccordance with policy GI3 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).

The window(s) in the northern elevation(s) of the proposed development shall: (a) be of purpose-madeobscure glass, (b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shallthereafter be retained in that form.REASON: To safeguard the residential amenities of neighbouring residents, in accordance with Policy GR1 ofthe Harrow Local Plan (2021-2026).

Within 3 months of the date of the decision notice, details of the works for the disposal of sewage to beprovided on site shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The developmentshall be carried out in accordance with the works so agreed and the works shall thereafter be retained.REASON: To ensure that there is adequate waste water infrastructure in place to serve the development andto ensure the separation of surface and foul water systems, in accordance with Policy CN3 and CN4 HarrowAdopted Local Plan (2021-2041).

The development hereby approved shall be undertaken in accordance with the details provided inPreliminary Ecological Appraisal by Arbtech dated 02/04/24 and Ecological Mitigation, Enhancement andManagement Plan Arbtech EMEMP dated 07/03/2024.REASON: To ensure that the development makes appropriate provision for the protection, enhancement,creation and management of biodiversity and ecological measures in accordance with policy G6 of TheLondon Plan (2021) and policy GI3 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)Order 1995 (as amended) (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order with or without modification), nodevelopment which would otherwise fall within Classes A, B, C, D, E and F in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to thatOrder shall be carried out in relation to the dwellinghouse hereby permitted without the prior writtenpermission of the local planning authority.REASON: To safeguard the character of the Conservation Area and openness of the Green Belt by restrictingthe amount of site coverage and size of dwelling in relation to the size of the plot in accordance with PoliciesG2 and HC1 of The London Plan (2021) and Policy GI1 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).

Within 3 months of the date of this decision notice, full details of the permeable paving construction and details relating to the long term maintenance and management of the on-site drainage shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.REASON: To ensure that the development has adequate drainage facilities, to reduce and mitigate the effects of flood risk and would not impact the character and appearance of the development, in accordance with The National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy SI13 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies GR1 and CN3 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).

All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in thefirst planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of thedevelopment, whichever is the sooner. Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 yearsfrom the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shallbe replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authorityagrees any variation in writing.REASON: To safeguard the appearance and character of the area, and to enhance the appearance of thedevelopment, in compliance with policies GR1 and GI4 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).

Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved drawings, no further construction works shall take place beyond the date of this decsion notice, until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority detailed sections at metric scale 1:20 through all external reveals of the windows and doors on each of the elevations. The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.REASON: To ensure that the development is carried out to the highest standards of architecture and materials in accordance with policy GR1 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).

No further development shall take place beyond the works already completed as of 30.06.2026, until aConstruction Method Statement has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planningauthority. The Method Statement shall provide for:(a) detailed timeline for the phases and implementation of the development;(b) the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors;(c) loading and unloading of plant and materials;(d) storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development;(e) measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during construction; and(f) scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from construction works.(g) type of vehicles to be used on, as well as to and from, site(h) hours of operation (delivery of materials,hours of which construction will take place on site and presence of workers on site)The development shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved details.REASON: In the interests of neighbouring amenity and highway safety

Within 3 months of the date of this decision notice, details of the levels of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and road/highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the level of the site, shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.REASON: To ensure that the works are carried out at suitable levels in relation to the highway and adjoining properties in the interests of the amenity of neighbouring residents, the appearance of the development, landscaping in accordance with policy GR1 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).

Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved drawings, within 3 months of the date of this decision notice, samples of the materials (or appropriate specification) to be used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority to be agreed in writing:a.Facing materials for the buildings, including roof;b.Details of the brick work bondc.Windows;d.Doors;e.Rainwater goods;f.Balconies;g.Ground surfacing.The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall be retained as such thereafter.REASON: To ensure that the development is carried out to the highest standards of architecture and materials in accordance with policy GR1 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).

Within 3 months of the date of this decision notice, a Self-Build BNG Exemption Statement shall besubmitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Statement shall demonstrate thatthe development qualifies for the self-build and custom housebuilding exemption from the biodiversity gainplanning condition and shall include:The Statement shall demonstrate that the development qualifies for the self-build and custom housebuildingexemption from the biodiversity gain planning condition and shall include:(a) details of how the dwelling is to be commissioned by an individual or individuals who will occupy thatdwelling as their home;(b) evidence that the individual(s) referred to in (a) has had primary input into the design and layout of theirdwelling;(d) details of the intended occupier (where known), and the mechanism by which they will commission thebuild;(e) a statement confirming that the development will consist exclusively of self-build or custom housebuildingwithin the meaning of section 1(A1) of the Self-build and Custom Housebuilding Act 2015. The statementshall include a statutory declaration setting out how the development complies with the self-build requirementsor the applicant's contract with a builder.(f) such other information as is reasonably required by the Local Planning Authority to verify that thedevelopment meets the criteria for exemption from the statutory biodiversity gain condition.The developmentshall be carried out only in accordance with the approved Self-Build BNG Exemption Statement.REASON: To enable the Local Planning Authority to determine whether the development qualifies forexemption from the statutory biodiversity gain condition, and to ensure that the development accords with therequirements for self-build and custom housebuilding, in accordance with Schedule 7A of the Town andCountry Planning Act 1990, the Biodiversity Gain Requirements (Exemptions) Regulations 2024, and section1(A1) of the Self-build and Custom Housebuilding Act 2015.

Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until therehas been a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the site submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), schedules of plants, notingspecies, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers / densities.Hard landscape works shall include; details of boundary treatments including walls, fences and gates(materials, scale of boundary, location), retaining walls (materials, location, height) and details of hardsurfacing materials to be used in the landscaping of the site.REASON: To safeguard the appearance and character of the area, and to enhance the appearance of thedevelopment, in compliance with policies GR1 and GI4 of the Harrow Adopted Local Plan (2021-2041).

Evidence of certification of Secured by Design Accreditation for the development shall be submitted toand approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before any part of the development is occupied orused.REASON: In the interests of creating safer and more sustainable communities and to safeguard amenity byreducing the risk of crime and the fear of crime in accordance with Policy GR1 of the Harrow Adopted LocalPlan (2021-2041).
